description: Implement a worker heartbeat system that monitors and reports resource utilization (CPU, memory, cgroups) to enable intelligent task scheduling and resource management. This should integrate with the existing worker infrastructure to provide real-time resource metrics alongside standard heartbeat functionality.
functional_requirements: Add resource monitoring capabilities to worker heartbeats, collecting CPU and memory usage data from the system
Integrate cgroups resource tuning functionality to read container-level resource constraints and utilization
Extend the worker heartbeat payload to include resource metrics alongside existing worker status information
Create a structured metrics collection system that can be tested across different environments (including non-Linux systems)
Ensure the resource monitoring works within the existing worker lifecycle and polling architecture
Add comprehensive testing for resource metric collection and heartbeat integration
